narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='m1'/>Twenty two and thirty three both divide sixty six, so they must be the numbers.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>Twenty two is two times eleven, and thirty three is three times eleven.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>They share eleven, so their highest common factor is eleven and not one.
